name: FPV Drone Game
desc:
FPV Drone Game is an open world PVP game where you fly FPV kamikaze drones into opponents.
Buy better explosives and batteries to get more power.

Controls
W - Forward
E - Up
D - Right
A - Left
S - Down
Mouse - Rotate Camera

Tags: FPV, explosion, drone, war, conflict, kamikaze, kamikaze drone, operator, realistic
